messages:
maria: FYI I've opened a docs PR to harmonize quota examples across pricing, metering, and SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5234. Goals: remove deprecated header `x-rw-usage`, show variable-based pricing math, add short guidance on tier fallbacks, and update dashboard permalinks.

noah: Thanks Maria. Can you include a tiny flowchart or ascii diagram for 'request -> check remaining -> choose batch size -> send'? That helps support teams.

maria: Added a minimal ASCII flow and a compact python snippet that checks `consumption.tiers[0].remaining_burst` before deciding to batch. Kept pricing examples as formulas (cost_per_token * token_count).

ria: Heads-up: console dashboard link changed last month; use the panel permalink and include the uid: `panel-usage-7a`. Also add a note that some on-prem installs won't have the same panel uid (call out redwood-vpc differences).

infra-bot: Noted. I opened ticket INFRA-873 to standardize panel uids in all environments.

maria: Also added brief migration note: "If you previously parsed x-rw-usage, switch to x-rw-consumption and account for nested tier arrays." Kept an example parse line for python.

noah: Quick nit: call out eventual consistency delay (40-90s) on quota endpoints. Customers often assume immediate updates after bulk top-ups.

ria: Approved from docs side pending infra confirmation about panel link.

maria: Eng-infra confirmed the permalink access for hosted customers. Merging after CI. Will post short release note and a tiny snippet PR to SDK repo with updated header parsing.

infra-bot: PR merged and backported to branch-1.1 by maria.
